_comment: Edit the copy THERE, not here, and run:

prompter.text: The same feed. A different thing to do about somebody.
Not the block button this time.
A follow context, and what I want to say in it.
Signed by my DELEGATE key. No phone, no handoff.
<identity> is everyone who is a person.
Back to the people I actually follow.
Still human, two hops away, through Tom.

beats.text:
This one is NOT reprehensible.
I am using the identity network to know WHO Tom is -- that part still works -- and saying separately that I am not interested in his opinions. Two different claims, and only one of them is about him being a person.

A Nerdster thing, not an identity-network thing.
And still public: anyone can read that I blocked Tom for a general-interest context. That is what an open network is, not a hole in one.

Everything is back.
<identity> follows everyone who is a person -- which we probably don't want often. Existing doesn't mean I care what you say.

Tom is still a person, and still how I know Eyal is one.
I stopped listening to him. I didn't unknow him.

lines: Know everyone. Follow who you like.
One identity network underneath, as many follow networks as you have interests.
You may trust a guy to rent your room but not to fix your car or recommend music.
